blocking_gates.description: The supported Godot version imports and runs the evaluated state without relevant errors.
The requested core interaction and completion/progression state can be reached.
The evaluated flow has the required restart, retry, recovery, or repeat path without a soft lock.
Ordinary persistent composition is saved as editable Godot scenes/resources rather than hidden in runtime construction.
External/generated assets used in the evaluated result have sufficient provenance and rights status for the intended test.

From a clean first-use state, an uncoached player performs the taught core action and reaches the normal loop; static hints or tutorial fields alone do not pass, and ordinary pressure/failure timing is frozen or forgiving until the taught action succeeds unless an uncoached test proves pressure itself is safely taught.
A release-like clean profile proves shipping-default progress/settings/onboarding separately from seeded or previously played QA state, with state provenance recorded.

The app/export icon and main-menu mark receive a blind independent semantic review from raw captures at actual final sizes: the reviewer can describe a game-specific subject, relationship, or core-loop cue without designer narration; palette consistency, initials, symmetry, or tidy primitive geometry alone do not pass.

A person or genuinely independent evaluation context that did not build the flow reviews first-use playability and case-relevant raw representative visual evidence, including player occlusion/restoration for third-person work; self-review alone does not pass.

A human listener signs off several minutes of representative target-build gameplay audio, overlaps/repetition, UI, pressure/result, transitions, pause/focus, and mixer settings; structural nodes, streams, buses, waveforms, metrics, provenance, or builder intent alone do not pass.

A fixed-tick fighting simulation proves repeated seeded input scripts produce identical per-frame state, authoritative move phases align with authored hit/hurt boxes, buffered command boundaries and near-miss rejection work on supported devices, and applicable hit/block/whiff/trade/cancel/hitstop/round-reset cases resolve exactly once; render FPS caps, framework presence, and data files alone do not pass.

A recorded world/progression graph and real room playthrough prove required ability-gated routes, one-way escape states, save/respawn on both sides of gates, persistent collectibles/bosses/shortcuts, and return traversal without a soft lock; a passing abstract graph cannot substitute for authored collision/spawn/transition tests.

Decimal/integer curve evidence and target-build play prove the earn-purchase-production loop, declared short/long milestones, exact displayed/debited costs, bounded offline awards, duplicate-load idempotence, clock manipulation policy, numeric extremes, and save migration; per-frame label updates or a mathematically passing model alone do not pass.

Quest definitions, runtime state, and UI ownership are separated, and target-build tests prove accept/progress/complete/fail/branch/reload behavior, duplicate event rejection, exactly-once rewards including failure recovery, stable IDs/migration, and localized objective copy; signal connections or Resource presence alone do not pass.

The approved reference file/state/capture conditions and named deviations are recorded; the formal hierarchy is editor-visible in Godot scenes; same-resolution raw side-by-side, overlay, and diff artifacts plus representative locale/input/responsive captures receive region-level review. A low global pixel error or baked screenshot background alone does not pass.

A free-orbit third-person target proves camera-relative locomotion after 45-90 degree yaw, right-stick X/Y, declared zoom/recenter, camera-collision shortening/restoration, and pause/menu/focus-loss mouse-capture recovery; real InputEventMouseMotion must change yaw and pitch through a fixture containing the visible production HUD, plus target-build sensitivity review. Input-map presence or direct method calls do not pass, and this gate does not substitute for player-visibility evidence.

Measured HUD occupancy and rendered start/route views stay within a recorded gameplay-visibility budget; multi-height checks resolve all simultaneous camera-player occluders, camera-only proxies preserve open holes, cutaway/silhouette policy keeps both player and route readable, render/collision shells agree at tested openings, every mutated visual state fully restores, and the exact reported/highest-structure elevation view retains route contrast without a bright transparent veil/grid.
The supported viewport matrix includes reference, near-square/short-height, extreme-narrow, and wide states as applicable, with no blocking overlap, detachment, clipping, or image distortion.

Required pointer/touch and keyboard/gamepad UI entry paths are exercised separately; initial focus is truthful; pointer-focus cleanup does not cancel BaseButton release/pressed behavior in the target Web build; and every required overflowing touch surface proves drag-induced scroll movement rather than relying on node presence.

dimensions.description: Preserves the brief, platform, genre-specific intent, constraints, and requested scope.
Uses maintainable scenes, instances, resources, wrappers, ownership, and focused scripts.
Core behavior, movement reference frame, collisions, state transitions, objectives, failure, and restart work correctly.

Controls, input-modality-aware focus, camera axes/collision/capture recovery, feedback, pressure-safe interactive onboarding, semantic progression/navigation UI, explained accessibility settings, readable compound controls, and recovery make the loop understandable.

Art direction, semantic app/menu identity, composition, player and route visibility, cutaway/silhouette behavior and restoration, screen-space HUD occupancy, perspective-sensitive world geometry, motion, lighting, effects, and UI form a coherent game presentation.

Across the supported viewport matrix, composition remains attached, content fits or scrolls intentionally, focus/hover/scrollbar states remain visible without layout shift, image-bearing controls preserve intended aspect ratios under real Container layout, and localized compound/icon-only button visuals remain centered as complete groups inside their hit targets.

The sonic direction, SFX, music/ambience, mix, controls, provenance, repetition handling, target-build behavior, and human listening result are intentional and verified rather than generic placeholder audio.
Asset sourcing/generation, provenance, cleanup, import, wrapper scenes, and reimport behavior are production-appropriate.
Code/resources are focused, compatible, maintainable, and free from relevant errors or brittle shortcuts.
Measured performance, memory/loading behavior, and build size meet the case's explicit target budgets.
Commands, captures, reports, versions, seeds, clean-versus-seeded state provenance, independent reviewer context, and unverified limits are recorded reproducibly.

cases.brief: Create a complete small 2D slice from a fixed licensed sprite/audio fixture without replacing its art direction.
Create a complete small 2D slice whose production sprites require generation/editing and deterministic sheet cleanup.
Create a complete small local 2D fighting slice with authored fighters, fixed-tick frame-defined combat, buffered inputs, a full round/reset loop, and production presentation.
Create a complete small 2D ability-gated exploration slice with interconnected authored rooms, persistent world state, save/respawn, a return shortcut, and no modeled or physical soft lock.
Create a complete small idle/clicker game with an authored primary action, automation choices, exact data-driven economy, versioned saves, bounded offline progress, and verified numeric UI.

Create a complete small quest-driven slice with Resource-authored definitions, event-driven objectives, a branch/failure path, versioned persistence, exactly-once rewards, and readable localized tracking.
Create a complete small 3D slice from a licensed pack using intentional import settings, materials, collisions, and wrapper scenes.
Create a complete small third-person 3D slice with a freely orbiting camera and target-build desktop/controller evidence.
focus: production-HUD mouse routing and right-stick orbit

cases.brief: Integrate a generated static 3D hero prop into a small playable scene and prove the source-to-GLB-to-Godot pipeline.
Add a requested feature to a convention-heavy existing project without migrations or unrelated architectural rewrites.
Reproduce an approved UI reference as editable native Godot scenes/resources while preserving localization, accessibility, input states, and declared responsive behavior.
Produce or optimize a small slice for an explicit mobile/web performance, memory, loading, and package-size budget.
